name: Intellex
description: A small command-line tool that hooks into Claude Code, Codex or Pi so that stored lessons are searched and shown at the start of a session or each prompt; it borrows mem0 or agentmemory for the actual storage.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI that installs hooks (Claude) or a prompt hook (Codex)

offline_no_account.value: Partly: mem0 mode needs an LLM key; embeddings stay local

plain_files.value: No: embedded vector store (mem0) or the agentmemory server

footprint.value: Medium: Bun, Python and mem0 with local embeddings

codex.value: Partial: prompt-time recall hook; no auto-capture

uninstall.value: ix setup <agent> --remove; backend data left alone
